_comment: Copy to identity.local.json and fill in your own values. That file is gitignored: it holds contact details and the claims you must never make. build.py reads it to verify every rendered PDF.
_phone_note: Digits only, no spaces or +. build.py strips non-digits from the PDF text and looks for this exact run.
_city_note: The English form appears in the CV; the local form replaces it in a letter written in the local language.
forbidden_claims: unfilled placeholder - REQUIRED, do not remove: the last guard against sending a template to an employer
EXAMPLE - replace EXAMNAME with a certificate or exam you do NOT hold but might plausibly be credited with
EXAMPLE - claims a language level above the one declared in my_profile/skills.md
EXAMPLE - undersells a project. Replace or delete.
_forbidden_note: Each entry is [python_regex, why_it_is_forbidden]. These are matched against the extracted text of every generated PDF; a hit fails verification. Keep the placeholder rule. Replace the EXAMPLE rules with the overstatements YOU must never make - typically a language level above what you can evidence, or a qualification you do not hold.

search._location_note: A LinkedIn place string, passed straight to the search endpoint.
search._commute_note: Your city plus every town you would actually commute to. Plain lowercase, umlauts written out (ue->u, oe->o, ss for sz). A posting whose location matches none of these is a hard fail and is filtered at the source.
search.out_of_scope: full-time posts, graduate programmes, and anything gated on a degree level above the one in education.md
